title: In Time of Tribulation
description: In Time of Tribulation in Tonic Solfa to ST. ALPHEGE, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 7 verses and a piano.
about: James Montgomery wrote these words. They were printed in the supplement of the 1866 edition of A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion, compiled by Samuel Longfellow and Samuel Johnson (Boston, 1866), as hymn 548, “In Time of Tribulation”.

The book printed the words without tunes, marked Sevens and Sixes (7.6.7.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ST. ALPHEGE; any other Sevens and Sixes tune fits them as well.
underlay: In time of tri-bu-la-tion, Hear, Lord, our ear-nest cries; With hum-ble sup-pli-ca-tion To Thee the spir-it flies.

lines: The years of Thy right hand,
Thy way is in great waters,
But let earth's sons and daughters
Through the wild sea Thou leddest
Still on the wave thou treadest,

source: A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1848)
licence: Public domain: James Montgomery died in 1854.
credits: Words by James Montgomery (1771–1854), public domain, as printed in A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1866); set to ST. ALPHEGE by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
